activity_summary: You wrote the share as thirty-three shillings. You wrote that the coffer was not opened, and that it stands as ruled at twenty pound fifteen. Heminges sends to Kettleby tonight. Monday is as billed. Kemp said tour, and the room did not agree. You did not make a new total.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the share, and did not open the coffer.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Sends tonight. The leaf is yours.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Said tour, and was not agreed with.

entities.name: Ambrose Kettleby
entities.context: The man the message goes to. Not in the house.

entities.name: thirty-three shillings
entities.context: Mentioned in Thirty-three, and the old ruling

facets.activity: Wrote thirty-three beside the old ruling
